podcast.title: Attempt to Influence 1987 UK Election
podcast.body: Red Wedge was a collective of musicians in the UK dedicated to engaging young people in politics. Their primary objective was to facilitate a shift from the conservative government to a Labour government in the 1987 election. Despite their significant efforts and the participation of numerous notable artists, their campaign ultimately failed, and Mrs. Thatcher secured another victory. "Their goal was to make a change from a conservative government to a labor one in the 1987 election."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
